camel_example: aliyun sas GetAssetsPropertyItem --region cn-hangzhou --Biz lkm --SearchInfo '/lib/systemd/s0000' --PageSize 20 --CurrentPage 1 --Lang en --ForceFlush false --SearchItem path
description_en: Queries the aggregated list of Asset Fingerprints for startup items, kernel modules, or websites
description_zh: 查询资产指纹启动项、内核模块或者Web站点聚合列表
kebab_example: aliyun sas get-assets-property-item --lang en --force-flush false --biz lkm --search-item path --search-info /lib/systemd/s0000 --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAssetsPropertyItem

parameters.help_en:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:

zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully refresh the data to be queried. Valid values:
true: Forcefully refresh.
false: Do not forcefully refresh
parameters.help_zh:
设置是否强制刷新待查询数据。取值：
true：强制刷新
false：不强制刷新
parameters.name: force_flush

parameters.help_en:
The type of Asset Fingerprints to query. Default value: sca. Valid values:

lkm: kernel module
autorun: startup item
web_server: website
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产指纹的类型，默认值为sca。取值：

lkm：内核模块
autorun：启动项
web_server：Web站点
parameters.name: biz

parameters.help_en:
The type of query condition. Set different aggregation search conditions based on the Biz parameter. Valid values:
If Biz is set to web_server, the following search conditions are supported for SearchItem:
    - domain: domain name
If Biz is set to lkm, the following search conditions are supported for SearchItem:
    - module_name: module name
If Biz is set to autorun, the following search conditions are supported for SearchItem:
    - path: startup item path
The SearchItem and SearchInfo parameters must be used together. Both parameters must be set at the same time for the query to take effect. Setting only one parameter does not take effect. You can use these parameters to query all data of a specific Asset Fingerprints entry by name
parameters.help_zh:
设置查询条件的类型，根据Biz参数设置不同的聚合搜索条件。取值：
Biz取值为web_server时，SearchItem支持的搜索条件如下：
    - domain：域名
Biz取值为lkm时，SearchItem支持的搜索条件如下：
    - module_name：模块名称
Biz取值为autorun时，SearchItem支持的搜索条件如下：
    - path：自启动项路径
SearchItem和SearchInfo这两个参数配合使用，通过同时设置这两个参数（设置一个无效），您可以按照资产指纹的名称查看指定名称资产指纹的所有数据
parameters.name: search_item

parameters.help_en:
The content to query. Specify different query content based on the value of SearchItem:
If SearchItem is set to domain, enter the domain name of the Asset Fingerprints entry.
If SearchItem is set to module_name, enter the module name of the Asset Fingerprints entry.
If SearchItem is set to path, enter the startup item path of the Asset Fingerprints entry.

The SearchItem and SearchInfo parameters must be used together. Both parameters must be set at the same time for the query to take effect. Setting only one parameter does not take effect. You can use these parameters to query all data of a specific Asset Fingerprints entry by name
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的内容。根据SearchItem取值的不同，您需要输入不同的查询内容：
SearchItem取值为domain时，您需要输入的查询条件为资产指纹的域名。
SearchItem取值为module_name时，您需要输入的查询条件为资产指纹的模块名称。
SearchItem取值为path时，您需要输入的查询条件为资产指纹的自启动项路径。

SearchItem和SearchInfo这两个参数配合使用，通过同时设置这两个参数（设置一个无效），您可以按照资产指纹的名称查看指定名称资产指纹的所有数据
parameters.name: search_info

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page when using paging. Default value: 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size
